title: DELETE /v1/operations/{operationId} (document-intelligence.v1)
description: Generation-bound operation cancellation. There is no list/get operation endpoint in v1: the only operation surface is this DELETE. The X-Operation-Generation header is required and must carry the 32-character lowercase hexadecimal generation token bound to the operation at submission. Cancellation is idempotent for that generation and wins over a late provider result; a stale token cannot cancel a newer operation that reused the same operation ID.

request.description: Logical request shape: operationId arrives as the path parameter, operationGeneration as the required X-Operation-Generation header. A missing or malformed header fails closed with INVALID_REQUEST.
